description: IRA owner born in 1953, age 72 in 2025: start age 73, so no distribution is required yet.
worked:
IRA owner born 1953-03-10; age attained on the 2025 birthday = 2025 - 1953 = 72. Beneficiary is not a spouse more than 10 years younger, so the Uniform Lifetime Table applies.
Required beginning age (IRC 401(a)(9)(C)(v) as amended by SECURE 2.0): born 1953 -> age 73; first distribution year = 1953 + 73 = 2026.
2025 is before 2026 (age 72 is under 73): no required minimum distribution for 2025; required amount 0.
